newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon gets $100 mln piece of NASA deal.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon gets $100 mln piece of NASA deal.

text.p: Raytheon Co's Raytheon E-Systems said on Thursday that it will participate in a National Aeronautics and Space Administration contract for developing and operating a Stratespheric Observatory for Infared Astronomy, with the company's portion having a value of about $100 million.
Raytheon said that the contract, which has been awarded to Universities Space Research Association, has a total value of $480 million.
The $100 million for Raytheon covers a five-year development period and the first five years of operations.
The company said the contract includes an option for an additional five years of operations.
Raytheon's role is to modify a 747SP aircraft to house a 2.5 meter infared telescope and associated mission control systems.
